SENSEX SURGES 898 POINTS TO 83,919.71 AND NIFTY HITS 25,800

On 20 November 2026, the BSE Sensex rose 898 points to end at 83,919.71, while the Nifty reached 25,800, marking a second consecutive day of gains.
The rise shows Indian markets defying a global rout, with banking stocks leading the surge, indicating investor confidence in the sector.
